title: Piemonte's Diesel Climb Outpaces Petrol as Both Fuels Hold Below the National Average
dek: Self-service Gasolio in Piemonte has risen nearly 3.2 cents in a week — more than double petrol's pace — even as the region stays a shade cheaper than Italy as a whole.
body: Piemonte's self-service Benzina averaged €2.0159 per liter and Gasolio €2.1485 on August 22, both fractionally below Italy's national self-service averages of €2.0208 and €2.1560. The gap is thin — well under a cent on either fuel — but it's enough to put Piemonte among the slightly more affordable regions for drivers who fill up at self-service pumps instead of paying the served-fuel premium, which runs roughly 16 to 17 cents higher per liter for both fuels here.

The more telling number is the direction of travel. Over the past week, self-service Gasolio in Piemonte climbed from €2.1169 to €2.1485 — up nearly 3.2 cents, or about 1.5% — while Benzina rose more modestly, from €2.0016 to €2.0159, roughly 0.7%. Diesel is outpacing petrol's increase by more than two to one. The region's station network stayed active through it: 1,847 stations are registered and 1,680 reported prices on the latest day, a 91% reporting rate that points to a well-monitored, actively-updating local market.

Catching a shift like diesel pulling away from petrol in one specific region only works if the numbers are fresh every single day — which is the whole premise behind Fuel Dashboard. Instead of a spreadsheet someone has to remember to update, the site pulls Italy's official MIMIT price feed and rebuilds itself automatically each morning, tracking every region's self-service and served prices day over day. It's a small, concrete example of what's possible when the daily grind of data wrangling is handed to an AI agent — built with Claude Code — rather than kept on a manual sheet.
pull_quote: Piemonte's diesel prices are climbing more than twice as fast as petrol — up 1.5% in a single week.
caption:
Today's Fuel Dashboard spotlight: Piemonte, where self-service diesel (Gasolio) has climbed nearly 3.2 cents in the past week — more than double the pace of petrol's rise over the same stretch. Both fuels in the region sit just a touch below Italy's national self-service averages.

Fuel Dashboard is a side project that tracks daily fuel prices across all 20 Italian regions, pulling directly from Italy's official MIMIT price feed. Each day it spotlights a different region, charts its 7-day price trend, and compares local prices to the national average — no manual spreadsheet required.

That last part is what I actually want to highlight: the entire pipeline — pulling the data, picking the day's region, writing the article, even this caption — runs itself using Claude Code. No manual CSV wrangling, no Excel upkeep. It's a concrete example of what's possible when you hand the daily-grind parts of a project to an AI agent and put your own time elsewhere.

Check out the live dashboard: https://adeo-blip.github.io/fuel-price-italy/
